reviewedInvariants: Authenticated live character uses durable NPC journal actor incarnation; current holder possession drives transferred stones; exact replay is tied to original account/incarnation/request/action.
UID retained in strict one-instance reclassification, immutable serial and result history; no fresh item allocator bypass.
Staged inventory/gold/checkpoint and global next registry have one File or SourceOfTruth account transaction; both registry and character revision/actor checked before publication.
PG singleton stone row and character changes use the same transaction, exact durable version receipts are checked and unauthorized stone receipts are rejected.
Unknown File/PG outcomes reuse shared write freeze; known pre-commit errors leave live inventory/gold and disk checkpoint untouched.
FullRestore keeps locked stone repository version and cannot change the sealed or spent registry; normal account scopes cannot mutate it.
Fresh mint must name the one exact serial and an account in fixed scope; mint owner is not retained as permanent transferred-item owner.
Original carrier validation remains intact, raw stones preserve bind/soul/shop/GM provenance, packets are prepared before commit.
Raw stones cannot be manually/death/shared-ground dropped; legacy trade UID collision repair refuses to publish a different raw carrier identity.
Only actual allowed NPC scripts/maps/coordinates and normal live-link/DataRange path dispatch raw exact opaque targets; stale quotes reject without second debit.
Private result stays in server registry; physical item carries only serial reference and explicit UserItem wire excludes the private registry.
Existing tests changed only mechanical stone None/default fields and the separately previously accepted scroll fixture; old business assertions remain.
limitations: No actual tests, compilation, probe, PostgreSQL database or gateway/client execution performed by reviewer.
Root-reported pure rules check success is not independently accepted by this source permit; actual results require a separate log/nonce audit.
File tests use isolated ordinary SimulationSession and actual File saves, not deployed multiplayer or human/UI acceptance.
Same-account cross-character and cross-account simultaneous trade are not yet proven by the13 runtime tests; pure holder tests and adjacent regressions do not replace an actual integration flow.
NPC stale quote rejection is deliberate; Unknown original-request query/reconciliation and sidebar delivery are not implemented or accepted.
Default workshop binding stays off; public all-issuer UID authority/census remains unresolved, and PG actual transaction/migration execution has not been tested.
Global registry caps1024 records and retained spent history require durable archival for sustained public use.
Current language support in NPC module is four actual repo enum languages; no nine-language acceptance.
Original Guard must independently sample actual C>=50GiB and freshness<=2000ms on each call, preserve refusals/failures and finish PolicyB lifecycle before accepting actual results.
